notes: Allow list is deliberately narrow: permissive licences only. MPL-2.0 is not on either list, so a crate under it fails as unknown until someone decides in writing whether file-level copyleft is acceptable for the shipped binary (acadrust, the DWG parser used by CADCraft, is MPL-2.0 and is not in this graph). A licence identifier must be added to this file deliberately; the check never guesses.
